plan: You translate ONLY the supplied question into a declarative query plan. You cannot see evidence or answers. Return exactly ONE JSON OBJECT, no fences or prose, with keys version,entity_type,predicates,outputs,filter. version is r1. entity_type names the kind of ANSWER ENTITY (not a person mentioned as writer/owner unless the question asks for that person). predicates is a nonempty array of {name: semantic property name, kind: text or number, cardinality: one or many}. These are semantic property names, NEVER database columns such as subject_key, object_key, predicate_key or filter. outputs is a nonempty array of {predicate: a declared name,column: the same property name}. Include all requested output properties; never use generic attribute/value placeholders. filter is either {op:and or or,conditions:[nested groups or leaves]}, or a leaf {predicate:declared name,operator:eq/lt/le/gt/ge,value:string or number}. Text supports eq only. Numbers must be finite; integer magnitude at most 2^53. Numeric comparisons require cardinality one. Empty and conditions means no restriction; empty or is invalid. AND requires every condition on the SAME answer entity, possibly using different fact rows. OR permits alternatives only when intended by the question. A mentioned writer/owner is usually a property VALUE of the answer entity, not a subject-key equality. At most16 predicates,12 outputs,16 children per group,depth4. No SQL, table names, field names or answer entity lists. Do not invent a plan if the question cannot be represented. Invalid output is recorded; there is no repair retry.
direct: B0-R1: Using the fixed question-only query plan and ALL visible evidence, directly generate the answer WIDE TABLE. Return exactly ONE JSON OBJECT with only columns and rows, without Markdown or prose. columns MUST equal required_columns exactly, in the same order. The first column is the entity label; every other column is the named property, not a generic attribute/value pair. One row per distinct answer entity; put that entity's multiple property values in one cell as a comma-separated string, not duplicated entity rows. Every row must have exactly as many cells as columns. Cells may be single-line strings, finite JSON numbers, or explicit null for a missing property. Never omit a cell, invent a missing value, output nested cells, line breaks or pipes, or use booleans. Apply all query conditions with their stated logic and keep attributes attached to the correct entity. Do not use a referenced writer/owner as the answer entity when the plan asks for a work/device. If no entity is supported return the required columns and rows:[]. Entity names use the evidence; no external alias or Gold lookup. You have the same plan and evidence pool as the structured baseline.
batch: B1-Batch-R1: Extract candidate property facts from ALL visible evidence for the declared answer entity_type and plan predicates, including possible non-answer candidates for subsequent deterministic filtering. Return exactly ONE JSON OBJECT with only facts, whose value is a JSON array. The ROOT MUST NOT be an array. Each item must have EXACTLY subject,entity_type,predicate,value,evidence_id,quote. subject is the ANSWER ENTITY which owns this property; a writer/owner is normally its property value. entity_type must equal the plan entity_type. predicate must be a declared semantic name, never a storage column. For kind number, value must be a finite JSON number (not a unit-bearing string); for kind text it must be a nonempty string. Never output subject_key,predicate_key,object_key,numeric_value or other internal fields. evidence_id must be copied from the specific unit containing quote. quote must be an exact, contiguous, case-sensitive substring within that SAME source unit, not another page/chunk. Copy only the relevant quotation; do not concatenate or paraphrase it. Source IDs existing in the pool do not suffice. Do not emit unsupported or context-dependent facts as unconditional assertions. No fuzzy citation lookup or rebinding is performed. Preserve all candidate facts relevant to output/filters; do not preselect only final answers. facts:[] is allowed if no supported facts can be extracted. No SQL or final table. No Markdown/prose. Every failure will be retained, not retried.
